headline_drivers: Agilysys reported fiscal Q4 2026 results on 2026-05-18 with adjusted EPS of $0.63 versus $0.50 expected and revenue of $82.9M versus $81.56M expected; recurring revenue was 65.5% of sales and subscription revenue grew 24% y/y.
Management guided fiscal 2027 revenue to $365M-$370M, above the ~$363.6M consensus, and said subscription revenue should grow at least 30% with adjusted EBITDA margins expanding to 24%.
Oppenheimer raised its AGYS price target to $100 from $90 on 2026-05-19 while keeping an Outperform rating, reinforcing the post-earnings re-rating.
summary: The market is reacting primarily to a clean earnings-and-guidance beat: Agilysys topped Q4 estimates, showed strong recurring-revenue mix, and then guided FY2027 above consensus with continued subscription growth and margin expansion. The stock’s recent pop looks like a re-rating of a higher-quality SaaS/recurring-revenue story rather than a new customer win or sector sympathy trade. The Oppenheimer target hike on 2026-05-19 helped extend the move, but the core catalyst is the beat-and-raise plus improved forward growth profile.
